directAnswer: To cast your phone to a TV, ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network and use the casting feature available in your phone's settings or compatible apps.
summary: Casting your phone to a TV allows you to stream content directly from your device. Different platforms may have specific steps to follow.

sections.heading: Casting from Android Devices
sections.body: Open the Quick Settings menu by swiping down from the top of the screen, then tap on 'Cast' or 'Screen Mirroring'. Select your TV from the list of available devices.

sections.heading: Casting from iOS Devices
sections.body: Swipe down from the upper right corner to access the Control Center, then tap on 'Screen Mirroring'. Choose your TV from the list to start casting.

sections.heading: Using Apps for Casting
sections.body: Many streaming apps like YouTube and Netflix have built-in casting features. Look for the cast icon within the app, tap it, and select your TV.

steps.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
steps.detail: Ensure both your phone and TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

steps.title: Enable Casting
steps.detail: On your phone, access the casting feature through Quick Settings (Android) or Control Center (iOS).

steps.title: Select Your TV
steps.detail: Choose your TV from the list of available devices to start casting.

steps.title: Start Streaming
steps.detail: Open a compatible app and select the content you want to cast.

faqs.question: What if my TV doesn't support casting?
faqs.answer: If your TV doesn't support casting, consider using a streaming device like Chromecast or Roku, which can enable casting functionality.

faqs.question: Can I cast without Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Some devices support direct casting via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi Direct, but this varies by device and may not support all content types.

faqs.question: Why is my casting lagging?
faqs.answer: Lag can occur due to a weak Wi-Fi signal, interference from other devices, or high network traffic. Try moving closer to the router or reducing the number of connected devices.

caveats: Not all TVs support casting; check your TV's compatibility.
Casting quality may vary based on network speed and device capabilities.
